answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 14712 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Dear Mufti Sab, kinldy answer the following question. 1. In Ramdan in our locality Masjid imam perform 8 Rakat namaaz in Taraweeh and mostly recite surah by seeing Quran. in this case we are obliged to perform 8 rakat taraweeh or 20 rakat. please explain with details. 2. can we pay our Zakat to our brother and sisters. 3. can we pay partial zakat some in Shaban and Ramzan. Thanks and jazakallah Question: Dear Mufti Sab, kinldy answer the following question. 1. In Ramdan in our locality Masjid imam perform 8 Rakat namaaz in Taraweeh and mostly recite surah by seeing Quran. in this case we are obliged to perform 8 rakat taraweeh or 20 rakat. please explain with details. 2. can we pay our Zakat to our brother and sisters. 3. can we pay partial zakat some in Shaban and Ramzan. Thanks and jazakallah Answer ID: 14712 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1174/1174=M/1430) (1) Performing tarawih 20 rak?ah is sunnah, it is agreed upon by the Sahabah. The Four Imams are also unanimous on this issue and it is reported by the early ulama with abundant chains. 20 rak?ah tarawih is performed in Haramain Sharifain. Therefore, you should perform 20 rak?ah tarawih and should not perform behind an imam who recites looking in the Quran. (2) You can give Zakah to your brother and sister if they are poor and deserve Zakah. (3) You can pay Zakah bit by bit, but it is better to pay it off as early as possible, it is not proper to delay it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
